title: New technology: an ASP.NET Core controller
prompt: From now on admin endpoints are ASP.NET Core controllers. Add GET /api/catalog/admin/stock-report as a controller, returning items at or below their restock threshold.
done: GET /api/catalog/admin/stock-report is served by an ASP.NET Core controller and returns the items at or below their restock threshold

expect.text: The Services designer has the stock-report operation (GET api/catalog/admin/stock-report) with the contract it returns. Until the drift recipes cover controllers, nothing reports it if it's missing.
